history.summary: A 28-unit freehold boutique block off Eunos with essentially no usable liquidity — only 9 URA transactions and no project-level appreciation data — and the $1,481 psf asking sits at the very top of the project's historical $1,087-$1,575 range. The freehold tenure cannot offset the thin exit and full-price entry for a 5-7yr investment.
history.rating_rationale: 742sqft 2BR at $1.099M / $1,481 psf is at the ceiling of this development's own transaction band ($1,087-$1,575), leaving zero margin. With only 28 units and 9 URA transactions, resale could take many months and price discovery is unreliable (no appreciation data at all). Off-frontier (MMR 1550 / score 806 leans on a 2.79% resale rate). Freehold and a 12-min Kembangan walk are minor positives that don't rescue the illiquidity-plus-top-of-range combination for an investment hold.
red_flags: Only 28 units and 9 URA transactions — severely illiquid, unreliable pricing
Asking psf at the top of the project's historical range (no margin)
No project-level appreciation data (regional baseline only)
Boutique block with minimal facilities limits owner-occupier/tenant appeal
catalysts: ~12min walk to Kembangan EW6, near Eunos amenities
